name: PricePerUse
description: Track the cost per use of your belongings and see their value decrease over time.

screens.name: ItemsScreen
screens.purpose: Display a list of added items and their current price per use.

features.name: item-list
features.description: Show items in a scrollable list, sorted by name.

features.name: item-details-navigation
features.description: Tap an item to view more detailed info.

features.name: delete-item
features.description: Swipe to delete an item from the list.

screens.layout: Vertical list of items with swipeable delete.

screens.name: AddItemScreen
screens.purpose: Allow users to add new items with a name, price, and date purchased.

features.name: add-item-form
features.description: Form to input item details (name, price, date).

features.name: submit-item
features.description: Save the new item to local storage.

features.name: date-picker
features.description: Select purchase date using a date picker.

screens.layout: Form with input fields and a date picker.

screens.name: StatisticsScreen
screens.purpose: Display charts and graphs showing price per use trends over time.

features.name: price-chart
features.description: Chart showing the price per use decreasing over time.

features.name: total-spent
features.description: Display the total amount spent on all items.

features.name: most-used-item
features.description: Display the item with the most uses.

screens.layout: Displays a chart and summary statistics.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Allow users to customize app settings (theme, notifications).

features.name: theme-toggle
features.description: Switch between light and dark themes.

screens.name: ItemDetailsScreen
screens.purpose: Show detailed information about a specific item and log new uses.

features.name: item-info
features.description: Display item name, purchase price, and current price per use.

features.name: log-use-button
features.description: Button to log a new use for the item.

features.name: use-log-list
features.description: List all use logs for the item.

screens.layout: Displays item details and a list of use logs.
